notes.plastic_purchase_per_finished_kg: USLCI rigid PP injection molding process reports 1.034 kg PP input per 1 kg part; applied as a proxy to all polymers and LDPE film.
notes.cardboard_purchase_per_finished_kg: Tiangong corrugated box process reports 1032.6 kg board per 1000 kg boxes.
notes.metal_purchase_per_finished_kg: Analyst assumption: no metal forming loss; likely understates the result.
notes.plastic_conversion_MJ_per_finished_kg: USLCI rigid PP injection molding reports 6.444 MJ electricity per kg part; used as a conversion-only proxy to avoid adding its PP resin and packaging a second time.
notes.metal_forming_kWh_per_finished_kg: Analyst assumption; no kettle-specific metal forming data were provided.
notes.assembly_kWh_per_kettle: Analyst assumption; no kettle factory meter data were provided.
notes.inbound_road_km: Analyst assumption applied to purchased mass; actual supplier routes and modes are unknown.
notes.brass_copper_mass_fraction: Analyst proxy for an unspecified brass grade; remaining 30% is modeled as zinc.
